steps.title: Every file name carries a hash
steps.titleZh: 每个文件名都带着哈希
steps.text: A content hash is a short fingerprint of a file's content, written into its name. The page loads three scripts: `runtime.<hash>.js` with webpack's loader, a file named by a number, which holds Lodash, and `main.<hash>.js` with your code. Same content, same name; new content, new name.
steps.textZh: 内容哈希（content hash）是根据文件内容算出的一小段“指纹”，写在文件名里。页面加载了三个脚本：装着 webpack 加载器的 `runtime.<hash>.js`，以一个数字命名、装着 Lodash 的文件，以及装着你的代码的 `main.<hash>.js`。内容不变，名字就不变；内容一变，名字也跟着变。

watch.label: Page scripts (not counting the guide)
watch.labelZh: 页面脚本（不含说明面板）

watch.label: Every name ends in a 20-character hash
watch.labelZh: 每个文件名都以 20 位哈希结尾

steps.title: Click the text
steps.text: `src/index.js` gives the `<div>` a click handler that calls `print` from `src/print.js` with `Hello webpack!`.
steps.textZh: `src/index.js` 给这个 `<div>` 加了点击处理函数，它用 `Hello webpack!` 调用 `src/print.js` 里的 `print`。

steps.title: Change one file, get one new name
steps.titleZh: 改一个文件，只换一个名字
steps.text: Edit `src/print.js`, for example change `console.log` to `console.info`, run `npm run build -w @latte/webpack` again and reload: only the `main` file gets a new name, while Lodash and the runtime keep theirs. The names are only half of caching: the server must also let browsers keep the files, with a `Cache-Control` header. `npm run dev` sends `no-store`, so nothing is cached there. This step asks the server for the header of the `main` file.
steps.textZh: 修改 `src/print.js`，比如把 `console.log` 改成 `console.info`，再运行一次 `npm run build -w @latte/webpack` 并刷新页面：只有 `main` 文件换了名字，Lodash 和运行时的文件名都没变。文件名只解决了缓存的一半问题：服务器还得通过 `Cache-Control` 响应头允许浏览器保留这些文件。`npm run dev` 发送的是 `no-store`，所以那里什么都不会被缓存。这一步会向服务器询问 `main` 文件的这个响应头。

action.run: const main = [...document.scripts].map((s) => s.getAttribute('src') || '').find((src) => /^main\./.test(src)); fetch(main).then((r) => console.log('Cache-Control for ' + main + ':', r.headers.get('cache-control') || '(none)'))
